decisions.navigate_ownership: BrowserSession.navigate accepts only pages in _owned (new_tab or popups of owned tabs) in both attached and isolated sessions; otherwise NotOwnedTabError(UnsafeActionError) code not_owned_tab, recommended_next_action new_tab
decisions.navigate_url_rules: Destination must pass BrowserSession._allowed_url (HTTP(S) with host or about:blank); service additionally applies web_url -> prohibited_url before any browser call
decisions.navigate_current_url: An owned tab currently on a protected document (e.g. chrome-error after failed navigation) may be navigated away; nothing of the protected page is read. Service does not apply the current-tab web_url check to navigate for that reason
decisions.navigate_lifecycle: Snapshots of the tab invalidated before goto (browser) and service cache/pending approvals for the tab dropped; Playwright TimeoutError -> navigation_status timeout + navigation_timeout diagnostic, tab retained; hard failure -> BrowserError code navigation_failed, owned tab retained (not closed, unlike new_tab which created it)
decisions.settle_detection: Public Playwright page events only, registered before input: request (is_navigation_request and frame is main frame) = cross-document navigation started; framenavigated(main frame) = commit (same-document when no navigation request preceded it); requestfailed/requestfinished of that request, download, close = ended. Settle window ends as soon as a navigation starts; otherwise after settle_ms with started false and no further waiting
decisions.settle_wait: Started cross-document: wait for commit (or end of request + 250ms grace) then wait_for_load_state(domcontentloaded), whole wait bounded by timeout_ms. Same-document: no document load to wait for -> status complete immediately. Request ended without commit (204, download, abort): status none + reason not_committed. Page closed: status none + reason page_closed
decisions.settle_defaults: settle_ms default 1000 for click/press/drag, 0 otherwise; zero still reports a navigation already started during dispatch. timeout_ms (1..120000, default 15000) validated for every operation; reload keeps its own navigation_status/wait_until
decisions.navigation_result: act result always includes navigation {started, status none|complete|timeout, url} (+reason when a started navigation did not commit or page closed, +timeout_ms diagnostic on timeout). It is a settle signal, never task success
decisions.navigate_failure_service_cache: Service drops tab cache on navigate success and on failures other than not_owned_tab/invalid_argument
decisions.result_extensions: Additive to contract: navigation.reason (not_committed|page_closed) and navigation.diagnostic on timeout; NavigationFailedError code navigation_failed for hard goto failures
decisions.f2_service_cache: _forget_tab(sid,*tabs) drops service snapshots+pending for the tab after act/approved_act (success, or failure when the engine no longer holds the revision or the error is stale_observation), navigate, run (run tab, active_tab, popup_tabs/active_tab in steps; done BEFORE re-caching a paused run's fresh snapshot+pending), approved upload/download (always, finally), close_tab (success). Pre-input act failures where BrowserSession.holds_observation is still true keep the cache
decisions.f2_check_observation: BrowserSession.check_observation(tab_id, observation_id, targets=()) under the lock: _snapshot + _validate incl. target-pixel comparison for visual targets among targets; no input. Service act calls it before minting approval_required; stale -> stale_observation, that observation and any pending for it removed from the service cache, no pending created. approved_act unchanged
decisions.f2_covered: snapshot.js clipRect() (refactor of visible() returning the clipped box) + one elementFromPoint at the guard's default point (center of clipped box) with shadow-root descent and composed contains, mirroring _GUARD. Covered exported targets keep name/signature/bounds but operations=[] and covered:true. Operations are already in _semantic_digest, so overlays appearing/disappearing invalidate older revisions; signature unchanged (no extra fingerprint cost). Provider choices come from operations, so covered targets are excluded without touching providers.py (not owned). Guard remains authoritative (explicit x/y in a partly covered target, parent-document iframe overlays). Cost: one hit test per exported element within the existing max_elements/max_nodes budgets
decisions.f2_behavior_change: An overlay appearing after observe now fails act as stale_observation (digest) instead of unsafe_action 'covered target'; test_stale_covered_wrong_tab_and_semantic_guards updated and a corner-overlay explicit-point case keeps proving the guard
decisions.f2_input_point: Verification found wrapped inline links (Wikipedia) flagged covered because the guard's default point was the bounding-box center (on unrelated paragraph text); this was also a pre-existing guard false rejection. snapshot.js now defines state.inputPoint(el, clippedBox) = center of the largest visible getClientRects() fragment (<=64 fragments; single-fragment elements unchanged), used by both the covered flag and _GUARD's default point. Explicit x/y points unchanged
decisions.f3_compact: service.compact_observation(observation, visual_regions=False): top level id, tab_id, url, title, text, truncated, next_offset, text_length, coverage{status,+reasons if partial}, page_state{state,summary,source}, visible_alerts[{role,text}], screenshot_status, screenshot (moved to MCP image block as before), diagnostic, visual_summary/visual_interpretation_error when present, omitted_elements, limitations (count), elements, visual_regions_omitted (count, only when >0). Element {id, role, name[:120], ops} + non-default value (input/textarea/select excluding checkbox/radio/button-like/file/hidden, <=200), checked/selected/disabled/covered/sensitive/multiple (true only), expanded (bool when aria-expanded present), href (links <=200), options (<=20 {value,label if different,selected,disabled} + omitted_options). Drops elements with no ops and no name
decisions.f3_cache: Service cache stores the FULL observation (minus screenshot) regardless of detail; approval classification unchanged
decisions.f3_full: detail=full returns the unmodified observation; only additive optional element fields expanded/selected/disabled (from aria-*) were added in snapshot.js and are not in the digest
decisions.f3_text_scope: snapshot.js option text_scope=document collects document_text (readable: nonempty text box, not visibility:hidden, no opacity-0 ancestor via memoized walk) with its own max_document_chars budget; viewport text and its budget (incl. frame headers) unchanged so _semantic_digest/_validate never see offscreen text. BrowserSession.observe(text_scope) uses document text for sections/snapshot text, so text continuation works. Offscreen iframes still skipped (limitations)
decisions.f3_run: run result.observation compacted after the paused-run cache insertion unless detail=full
decisions.f3_href: Real-page check: compact was 36.1% (HN) / 34.6% (Wikipedia) of full; dominant element bytes were href (absolute same-origin URLs), id, ops. Same-origin link hrefs are now emitted origin-relative ('/item?id=..', lossless against observation url) -> 31.9% / 31.3%. Remaining: ids (f+32-hex document token+':n', engine contract/security token, unchanged) and ops (real capabilities, e.g. native link drag), not treated as noise
decisions.f4_policy_module: approval_policy.py: approval_mode_from_env (BROWSER_APPROVAL_MODE strict|standard|autonomous, default standard, strip+lowercase, invalid -> ApprovalPolicyError code invalid_approval_mode), requires_approval(tier,mode), classify_action (port of legacy _approval_reason + reload tiering), approval_reason (strict == legacy), classify_navigation, classify_transfer, classify_network (+NETWORK_REASON_TIERS), classify_redirect, recovery_requires_approval, audit
decisions.f4_parity: tier=='none' iff the legacy classifier returned None, and the legacy reason string is always returned unchanged; strict threshold=ordinary, so strict reproduces legacy decisions and reasons by construction and strict ⊇ standard ⊇ autonomous. Verified by a table test against a frozen verbatim copy of the legacy function over ~40k element/action combinations plus reload pages
decisions.f4_tiers: critical: sensitive fill/select; click or Enter/Space whose name/role/href/form_action matches payment (buy, pay(ment), purchase, checkout, place order, transfer/send money) or account deletion; network credential-header edits or payment-like URL (incl. redirect hops; cross-origin hop carrying credential-like headers). consequential: legacy risky/submit click reason; custom control in POST form or named log out/sign out; Enter/Space on submit/risky/POST-form/log-out controls or targetless; reload with data-risk reason; upload/download; non-safe/foreign/body/consequential-URL network; navigate to risky URL names. ordinary: other custom/visual controls, other Enter/Space, drag, reload without data risk. none: legacy no-reason
decisions.f4_link_logout_deviation: Links named 'Log out' stay tier none (legacy returned no reason); making them consequential would make standard stricter than strict. Buttons/custom controls named log out are consequential (legacy already paused them in strict)
decisions.f4_service: mode re-read from env per dispatch; doctor reports approval_mode (+approval_mode_error); every other command fails with invalid_approval_mode. act: classify -> pause (binding unchanged; result adds tier/approval_mode; pending stores tier/mode) or execute with approval audit when tier!=none. approved_act adds host_token audit (run-paused pending tiered from cached snapshot). navigate: risky URL -> binding {session_id, operation:navigate, tab_id, url, reason}; resume by repeating navigate with approval_token; audit on success. upload/download: strict/standard keep legacy token lookup (_approve(binding, token)) ; autonomous runs under standing approval when BROWSER_FILES_DIRECTORY set; download click tier included (critical click still needs token). run passes approval_mode to BrowserAgent; observe composes page_state with mode. network_call/replay pass approval_mode to the engine; executed results get audit; network_execute adds host_token audit
decisions.f4_network: RequestExecutor.prepare(approval_mode=None -> env): reasons unchanged; approval_required = BROWSER_NETWORK_REQUIRE_APPROVAL or requires_approval(classify_network(reasons), mode); preview adds approval_tier/approval_mode; Plan stores mode and host flag. Redirect hop needing re-approval: (cross-origin or risky) and (host flag or requires_approval(hop tier, plan mode)); followed hops in autonomous carry an approval audit
decisions.f4_agent: BrowserAgent(approval_mode='strict' default for library compatibility); _approval_reason(..., mode='strict') delegates; step records carry approval audit (host_policy or host_token via callback); compose_page_state(..., mode)
decisions.f4_test_env: Transport tests that exercise pre-mode pausing of ordinary actions (MCP drag, websocket 'Socket' button, ordinary reload, F2 stale-approval 'Free action') pin BROWSER_APPROVAL_MODE=strict explicitly
decisions.f4_word_refinement: Parent-required: consequential needs whole-word risk name (links: leading imperative word, added after the Wikipedia smoke paused 'Hypertext Transfer Protocol'), submit/risky/POST form, or action-like URL segment/query token (delete|remove|logout|log-out|signout|sign-out|unsubscribe|subscribe|submit|publish|send|confirm|accept|authorize|transfer|checkout|purchase|buy|pay bounded by [/?&=;] and [/?&=;.#]); substring-only legacy matches -> ordinary. Same for classify_navigation (substring-only -> ordinary) and network 'URL names' reason. Tier none-ness unchanged (parity). Critical rules unchanged: known remaining false-positive class, e.g. a content link named 'Payment' or href '/how-to-buy-x' is critical
decisions.f4_link_cap: Parent decision 2026-10-11: plain link activation (role link, no submit/POST/risky) is a GET navigation; payment-like link names/hrefs capped at consequential. Buttons, submit controls, forms, sensitive fills and network plans keep the critical floor. Tier none-ness unchanged
decisions.f4b_retry: BrowserSession.observe holds the lock and calls _observe_once (unchanged single read-only collection + screenshot revalidation) up to 3 attempts within a 1.5 s deadline, backoff 0.15*attempt s; only StaleObservationError is retried (collection-phase or revalidation stale; observe never dispatches input); each retry discards the failed revision and collects a new one. Success after retry adds settle_retries (also in compact output). Exhaustion re-raises the stale error with diagnostic {code: page_settling, observe_attempts, message, cause?}. act/check_observation/upload/download unchanged (fail-fast)

research.facts: goto wait_until commit/domcontentloaded/load(default)/networkidle(discouraged); same-URL hash navigation succeeds and returns None; timeout default 30000; wait_for_load_state resolves immediately when current document already reached the state; wait_for_event/expect_event throw when page closes; on('framenavigated') emitted when a frame navigates to a new url; main_frame persists during navigations

client keeps per-frame _load_states updated by loadstate add/remove; page framenavigated is emitted only for navigated events without error; expect_navigation waits for any navigated event then load state

frameCommittedNewDocumentNavigation calls _onClearLifecycle before firing the navigation event, so wait_for_load_state after a new-document framenavigated waits for the new document; frameCommittedSameDocumentNavigation fires navigated without clearing lifecycle; aborted navigations fire an error event that is not a public framenavigated
